steps.expression: ((result) => { if (!result || !result.ok) return { ok: false, message: '运行结果数据不存在' }; if (!result.matchedTemplateIds || result.matchedTemplateIds.length === 0) return { ok: false, message: 'matched_template_ids为空' }; if (!result.matchedImgUrls || result.matchedImgUrls.length === 0) return { ok: false, message: 'matchedImg为空' }; if (!result.matchedTemplateUsedIds || result.matchedTemplateUsedIds.length === 0) return { ok: false, message: 'matched_template_used_ids为空' }; if (!result.matchedTemplatePkg) return { ok: false, message: 'matched_template_pkg为空' }; return { ok: true, message: '所有必填字段都存在', templateCount: result.matchedTemplateIds.length, imgCount: result.matchedImgUrls.length, usedIdCount: result.matchedTemplateUsedIds.length }; })(detailedRunResult)
steps.description: 验证运行结果的必填字段都存在

steps.expression: ((result) => { if (!result || !result.ok) return { ok: false, message: '运行结果数据不存在' }; const expectedCount = 4; const actualCount = result.matchedTemplateIds.length; if (actualCount !== expectedCount) return { ok: false, message: `模板数量不匹配，期望${expectedCount}个，实际${actualCount}个` }; return { ok: true, message: `模板数量正确：${actualCount}个` }; })(detailedRunResult)
steps.description: 验证匹配到的模板数量是否符合预期（目标匹配数量=4）

steps.expression: ((result) => { if (!result || !result.ok) return { ok: false, message: '运行结果数据不存在' }; const imgUrls = result.matchedImgUrls; for (const url of imgUrls) { if (!url.startsWith('http')) return { ok: false, message: `图片URL格式错误：${url}` }; if (!url.includes('alicdn.com') && !url.includes('taobaocdn.com')) return { ok: false, message: `图片URL域名不正确：${url}` }; } return { ok: true, message: '所有图片URL格式正确' }; })(detailedRunResult)
steps.description: 验证图片URL格式是否正确

steps.expression: ((result) => { if (!result || !result.ok) return { ok: false, message: '运行结果数据不存在' }; const usedIds = result.matchedTemplateUsedIds; for (const usedId of usedIds) { const parts = usedId.split('_'); if (parts.length !== 3) return { ok: false, message: `matched_template_used_ids格式错误：${usedId}，应该是sellerId_pkgId_templateId` }; const [sellerId, pkgId, templateId] = parts; if (!sellerId || !pkgId || !templateId) return { ok: false, message: `matched_template_used_ids字段缺失：${usedId}` }; } return { ok: true, message: '所有matched_template_used_ids格式正确' }; })(detailedRunResult)
